sources.title: Urdatorn/sphragis-alm-olmo3-greek-7b-plato · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Each model is a full further-pretraining of Urdatorn/olmo3-7b-ancient-greek on one author's Sphragis training sentences only; a sentence is attributed to whichever of the seventeen models finds it least surprising. This model was trained on Plato: 900 sentences, 104,702 scored tokens from the sentence_1 training split.
